args.manifest:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: host-agent-site
  labels: {app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opute-host-agent}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: www-${vars.inputs.siteVersion}
  namespace: host-agent-site
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: host-agent-www, app.kubernetes.io/version: '${vars.inputs.siteVersion}'}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: host-agent-www, app.kubernetes.io/version: '${vars.inputs.siteVersion}'}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: www
          image: ${vars.inputs.image}
          ports: [{name: http, containerPort: 80}]
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: {path: /healthz, port: http}
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 15
          resources:
            requests: {cpu: 25m, memory: 32Mi}
            limits: {cpu: 200m, memory: 128Mi}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: host-agent-www
  namespace: host-agent-site
spec:
  selector: {app.kubernetes.io/name: host-agent-www, app.kubernetes.io/version: '${vars.inputs.siteVersion}'}
  ports: [{name: http, port: 80, targetPort: http}]

clusterUri.description: The K3s cluster that serves the site.

image.description: The public site image, pinned to its manifest digest.

runNonce.description: A new value starts a new run with the same inputs; it finds every effect in place and skips.

siteVersion.description: Names this image's Deployment; a new image needs a new version (for example its digest's first 12 digits).
